title: Coles Myer Limited - proposed acquisition of Hedley Liquor Group

body_sections.Summary: Coles Myer Limited (CML) proposed acquisition of Hedley Liquor Group (HLG).
body_sections.Market definition: The ACCC considered the impact of the acquisition primarily on the market for retail packaged liquor for off-premises consumption in local areas in Queensland.
body_sections.Competition analysis: The majority of HLG's outlets are located in northern Queensland where CML has no presence.  Generally, CML has a relatively small presence in Queensland.  In the small number of local markets where CML and Hedley both compete, the ACCC considered that the acquisition was unlikely to result in a substantial lessening of competition because of the existence of other competitors that would be likely to act as a competitive constraint on the merged entity.
